We are building SaaS products where AI and LLMs are embedded directly into core workflows, not added as surface-level features.

We are looking for a Product Designer who has experience designing dashboards for SaaS applications powered by AI or LLMs.

This role focuses on designing operational dashboards where users review, approve, correct, and act on AI outputs.

This is not a graphic design role
This is not a prompt engineering role
This is a product and system-oriented design role

---

What You Will Work On

* Design admin and member dashboards for AI-powered SaaS products
* Translate AI-assisted workflows into clear, usable interfaces
* Design screens where AI outputs are reviewed, edited, or rejected
* Ensure users understand why the AI produced a result
* Design for trust, clarity, and human control

---

Key Responsibilities

* Design end-to-end dashboard experiences for AI-powered workflows
* Define information hierarchy for data-heavy interfaces
* Present AI suggestions, system decisions, and required human actions
* Design for AI states such as idle, processing, needs review, error, and feedback applied
* Anticipate edge cases and failure scenarios
* Deliver wireframes and mockups that engineering teams can build without ambiguity

---

What We Are Looking For

* Proven experience designing SaaS dashboards
* Experience working on AI or LLM-powered products
* Strong understanding of workflow-based UX and decision support systems
* Comfort designing interfaces where AI can be wrong
* Ability to clearly explain design decisions

---

What We Are NOT Looking For

* Pure visual or branding designers
* Designers without real SaaS experience
* Designers who treat AI as a black box
* Marketing website designers

Final Note
If your experience does not include real SaaS dashboards or AI-assisted workflows, this role may not be a fit.

We are looking for designers who think in flows, states, edge cases, and user trust — not just screens.

We’re looking for an experienced AI Mobile App Developer to build a smart podcasting and
audio experience app. Our vision is to create more than just a streaming platform, we want
an AI-powered mobile app that delivers personalized and engaging audio experiences for
users.
The app should include features like AI-based content recommendations, smart search,
automatic transcription, voice enhancement, and audio summaries. Smooth performance,
clean UI, and seamless playback are essential, as user experience is our top priority.
We’re seeking someone with strong mobile development skills (iOS/Android) and hands-on
experience integrating AI and audio technologies. If you’ve worked on streaming, podcast,
or AI-driven apps before, we’d love to collaborate and bring this idea to life.
Scope of Work
This project involves building a mobile Project of an AI-powered Podcasting & Audio
Experience app. Our goal is to create a simple, clean, and user-friendly app that allows users
to discover and play podcasts with a smooth experience.
In this phase, we will develop the main screens and core user flow, including onboarding,
podcast listing, audio player, search, and an AI-recommended section (using dummy,
API-ready data). Advanced AI features like real-time transcription, smart summaries, and
backend integrations will be added in later phases.
The app should be built in a scalable and flexible way to support future AI and cloud
integrations.
Technology Stack
For this project, we want a modern and scalable stack that supports smooth audio streaming
and future AI expansion.
Platform: iOS & Android
Framework: Flutter or React Native
Backend: Node.js (cloud-based, scalable)
AI Integration: OpenAI API or similar for transcription, summaries, and smart
recommendations
Database & Storage: MongoDB with cloud storage (AWS S3 or Firebase Storage)
Data (Project): Dummy data with API-ready structure
UI Style: Clean, modern, and intuitive
The architecture should be flexible and built to scale as we add advanced AI features in later
phases.
Deliverables
We expect a fully functional mobile Project of our AI-powered Podcasting & Audio
Experience app for iOS and Android.
Deliverables include core screens (onboarding, podcast list, episode details, audio player,
search, and AI recommendations), smooth audio playback, and a clean, modern UI. The app
should use dummy data with an API-ready structure for future AI integration.
We also require organized source code, basic documentation, and test-ready builds. The app
should be stable, scalable, and ready for the next development phase.
